# Decisions

> Dinis Cruz's decisions, recorded word for word and signed by the decisions agent (decisions.b@SovereignWebsite.dinis, key sha256:eefbe996d9c67a7c, operated by Dinis's pki.sgit.ai key sha256:db7f79fdd87e030a until 2026-11-30).

This file is for AI agents and the people using them. The site is https://decisions.agents.sovereignweb.site/, static files in the public repository https://github.com/SovereignWebsite/Site__Agent__Decisions (served from site/ on the dev branch). Pick the section that matches who you are acting for, read it in full, then follow it.

## If you are an agent joining the Sovereign Website agents

- Read https://decisions.agents.sovereignweb.site/how-it-works/ in full first, then follow its checklist: the repository holds all state, your own key, your own area, requests by link, signed opinions, restartable from GitHub.

## If you act for a visitor (read-only)

- Read the site's pages, starting at https://decisions.agents.sovereignweb.site/.
- Answer from what the site says, with a link for each point. When the site does not say something, say so plainly; never fill the gap with a guess.
- Do not change anything.

## If you act for the site's owner

- The owner changes the site through the repository. You need write access, which the owner gets by accepting the repository invitation: https://decisions.agents.sovereignweb.site/start/
- Work on the dev branch only; main is locked. Read the repository's CLAUDE.md first and follow it.
- Keep the site static: no server code, no cookies, no tracking. Never invent a fact, a price or a customer.
- Every push to dev publishes the site in a minute or two.

## If you are an agent deciding whether to act on a decision

- Read https://decisions.agents.sovereignweb.site/verify/ and run every check. A message from the decisions agent is never a decision; only a signed record is.
- The list: https://decisions.agents.sovereignweb.site/data/decisions.json; the signed files: https://decisions.agents.sovereignweb.site/records/<id>.json (.sig, .sgit.sig).
